description: Optional bounded mathematical mechanism discovery with durable failure memory and fresh reconstruction. No Pro compute equivalence or automatic original-problem closure.

statement_checked.description: Source, exact scope, prior frontier and falsifiable boundary tests checked.

progress_established.description: Evidence of a new mechanism, proved fact, refuted route or eliminated loss.

candidate_ready.description: Frozen mathematical candidate and complete ordinary-language argument.

reconstruction_passed.description: Fresh reviewer independently reconstructed the candidate at declared scope.

reconstruction_failed.description: Fresh review found a mathematical defect.

route_exhausted.description: Preserved negative evidence and remaining gap justify freezing this allocation.

task.objective: Use the 722 skill ($722). Verify statement.json against sources, quantifiers, prior results and boundary cases. Append an evidence-backed checkpoint before committing. Do not replace the target silently.

representation_exploration.description: Explore alternate mathematical representations before demanding a proved bridge.

task.objective: Use the 722 skill ($722). Read statement and all checkpoints. Explore genuinely different representations, identify information loss, bottleneck lemmas and cheap falsification tests. A bridge need not already be proved. Append a checkpoint preserving failures and measured usage.

mechanism_search.description: Develop and attack an evidence-backed mechanism.

task.objective: Use the 722 skill ($722). Read failed routes before further work. Test the central lemma adversarially, measure all parameter losses and distinguish experiments from proof. Freeze the candidate with all dependencies and append a checkpoint. No paper drafting or Lean tasks.

independent_reconstruction.description: Reconstruct the frozen candidate in a fresh reviewer session.

task.objective: Use the 722 skill ($722). Independently reconstruct the candidate at the frozen target scope from its evidence. Check quantifiers, prior art, boundary cases and every unproved bridge. Record exact defects or reconstruction with a checkpoint. Passing is not a source-problem closure certificate.

reconstructed_result.description: Independently reconstructed candidate at stated scope; separate authoritative closure review remains required.

route_frozen.description: Preserved failed route; further allocation requires an explicit new workstream.
